title: Small-Group San Diego Afternoon Sailing Excursion
includes: Complimentary non-alcoholic beverages and light snacks.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please note: Each booking is limited to six (6) passengers. If you have friends or family booking separately, please let the operator know in advance to ensure you're on the same boat; otherwise, you may be seated on different boats.
You must contact Sail San Diego after purchase for the exact departure time, as departure times vary throughout the year.
This is not a guided tour; our captains don't provide a commentary but are always happy to share what they know! Don't be shy asking questions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This three-hour adventure on a a beautiful modern-day sailboat is limited to just 6 people, allowing you a comfortable, semi-private experience (or, grab five friends and fill up the whole boat!). Sit back, relax and enjoy the complimentary beer, soft drinks and snacks as you soak in the warm sun and Bay sights.

Departure times vary throughout the year. Guest must contact Sail San Diego after purchase for the exact departure time. Please note this activity does require a minimum of 3 guests total in order to sail.

If members in your group are booking their tickets separately, please call Sail San Diego so they can ensure you're on the same boat. If they don't know ahead of time, you may be seated on separate boats!
